plan.notes: Source: official 2025-2026 SAU Undergraduate Catalog (PDF), College of Science and Engineering, Suggested Plan of Study for BS Engineering Science: Industrial Technology, plan lines 22538-22618. Sequenced credit sum = 120, matches the plan's printed 'Total hours required for major - 120'. Plan wording kept verbatim: 'MATH 2124 Applied Calculus 5' (requirements read 'MATH 2125'); 'ITEC 4703/4712 Work Experience or Upper-Level Technical Elective' 3 and 2 credits; the semester-1 through 6 placeholders read '**Basic Course Elective' with the options footnote; '*ITEC 3503 Computational Methods' (asterisk: prerequisite may be substituted with instructor consent). Stray '4' glyph at plan line 22546 was a table-extraction artifact and is not sequenced. ENGR 2020 Engineering Exams: 0-credit course the SAU catalog requires engineering students to register for each fall and spring semester (used as exam period) — genuine repeated zero-credit requirement.
